insight: Raised $400M at a $2.4B valuation in 2024 led by Jeff Bezos and OpenAI, with a team drawn from Tesla, DeepMind, and X.
name: Physical Intelligence
tagline: General-purpose foundation models that aim to control any robot to do any task.
description: Physical Intelligence is a San Francisco lab building general-purpose AI for the physical world. Its π0 (pi-zero) vision-language-action model, built on a pretrained VLM and trained across many robot embodiments, can perform dexterous tasks like folding laundry. The company open-sourced π0's code and weights via its openpi repository.

modelSupport.notes: Vision-language-action robot foundation models; weights released openly.

edge: Open-sourced its flagship robot VLA: π0's code and weights ship in the public openpi repo, rare for a frontier lab.
pros: Open code and weights via openpi
Built on a pretrained vision-language model
cons: Research artifact, not a turnkey product
Needs robot hardware and ML expertise

references.title: Physical Intelligence says its new robot brain can figure out untaught tasks
